items.title: OpenAI Engineer Accused of Spying on Executives Ordered to Remain in Custody
items.summary: A judge ordered Abdulrahman Alfozan to remain in custody, likening the Saudi government’s offer to secure the former OpenAI engineer’s release to a “blank check.”
items.author: Paresh Dave

items.title: WhatsApp Help Pages Leaked Hidden Instructions for a Meta Chatbot
items.summary: Around 80 pages on WhatsApp’s website exposed instructions that were designed for its chatbot, including “WHAT NOT TO SAY.” Meta says a bug caused the issue.
items.author: Matt Burgess

items.title: Disney Asked Character.AI to Go Bankrupt for a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card
items.summary: The entertainment giant hopes to get trust and safety tech, among other IP, from a startup whose chatbots dozens of states allege encouraged minors to self-harm and kill their parents.
items.author: Maddy Varner
